title: c00lFlood HD 1.0 / HD Admin
features: This is a recreation of the c00lkidd flood script using the Crossbow of the Sea via ;give commands, dont expect it to be 100% accurate cause it goes only to random positions and its my first script but ill work on it more when my skills get better, it wasnt made only by me, I had a little help from roblox dev forums and tutorials and you’re allowed to use it in your own F3X c00lgui aslong as you give proper credits!
script:
-- c00lFlood HD 1.0 release
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Gets the savior of this whole script
local hdEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("NoticeSound", true)
if hdEvent and hdEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    hdEvent:FireServer(";gear me 236438668")
else
    -- Fallback something idk
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(";gear me 236438668")
    else
        ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(";gear me 236438668", "All")
    end
end

-- Wait for the crossbow to find its way into the inventory
task.wait(2.2) 

-- Idk what to say
local targetCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Equipped or unwhipped?
local function FindCrossbowObject(container)
    if not container then return nil end
    for _, item in pairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Tool") and (item.Name:match("Crossbow") or item.Name:match("SeaThemed")) then
            return item
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local crossbowEquipped = FindCrossbowObject(targetCharacter)
local crossbowInBackpack = FindCrossbowObject(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))

-- Holy shit we’re now welcoming Crossbow hello crossbow!!
local Crossbow = nil

if crossbowEquipped then
    -- Uhh its in your hand wdym give it to you
    print("Crossbow is already equipped. Moving to next line...")
    Crossbow = crossbowEquipped
elseif crossbowInBackpack then
    -- Equipping FLOOD CROSSBOW 2026 FE BYPASS NOT VIRUS
    print("Found Crossbow in backpack! Equipping now...")
    crossbowInBackpack.Parent = targetCharacter
    Crossbow = crossbowInBackpack
else
    -- Delete System32
    print("Crossbow not found. Stopping script..")
    return
end

-- FLOOD HELL YEAHH
local FloodActive = true
print("c00lFlood activated; Q to deactivate")

-- Awh man no flood..
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        FloodActive = false
        print("R.I.P c00lflood, 2026 to.. whatever year it is")
    end
end)

-- Uhh localized blah blah grid blah blah lalala
task.spawn(function()
    -- Dynamically captures where you are standing right when you execute
    local originPos = HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local rng = Random.new()
    
    -- Holy shit we just made Character wowie
    while FloodActive and Crossbow and Crossbow.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character do
        -- Distributed grid values relative to your original activation position
        local randomX = rng:NextNumber(-500, 500)
        local randomY = rng:NextNumber(15, 1000) 
        local randomZ = rng:NextNumber(-500, 500)
        
        -- Teleportation offset from originPos
        HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(originPos + Vector3.new(randomX, randomY, randomZ))
        
        -- SHOOT!! SHOOT!! SHOOT!!
        local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if Camera then
            -- Wowie calculations
            local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
            local centerX = viewportSize.X / 2
            local centerY = viewportSize.Y / 2
            
            -- Project the ray thing to flood your enemies
            local centerRay = Camera:ViewportPointToRay(centerX, centerY)
            
            -- Whatcha doin crosshair?
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character} -- Ignores your character
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            
            local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(centerRay.Origin, centerRay.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
            local targetPosition = centerRay.Origin + (centerRay.Direction * 1000) -- Default far point
            
            if raycastResult then
                targetPosition = raycastResult.Position
            end
            
            -- Skid support
            local remoteEvent = Crossbow:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteEvent") or Crossbow:FindFirstChild("Remote", true)
            if remoteEvent then
                -- Inject virus into network
                remoteEvent:FireServer(targetPosition)
            else
                -- Fallback
                Crossbow:Activate()
            end
        else
            -- Extra fallback.. for some reason
            Crossbow:Activate()
        end
        
        -- Delay so your game doesnt deactivate System32
        task.wait(0.05) 
    end
end)
